{{Quote|Infidel! You shall not escape the Reverend Oni'antae!|A Dark Veil Order pilot|<ref name="SWG:DS" />}}
Reverend '''Oni'antae Soli-nacae''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] leader of the [[Dark Veil Order]], a matriarchal religious order active in the [[Dathomir system/Legends|Dathomir system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Oni'antae Soli-nacae frequently piloted a [[Rihkxyrk assault fighter]] in the Dathomir system.<ref name="SWG:DS" />
{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TempGenericPirate.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Reverend Oni'antae Soli-nacae]]
Oni'antae Soli-nacae appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Reverend Oni'antae Soli-nacae was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]]. Oni'antae Soli-nacae was a starfighter boss that had a low probability to spawn among a group of Dark Veil Order starfighters in the Dathomir system.<ref name="SWG:DS" />
